posts.body_markdown: Reusable lemma for the expander integrator: if `e_1=0,e_2,…,e_m` span `F_2^h`, `m≤34,915`, and every nonzero character satisfies `|Σ_i(-1)^{a(e_i)}|²≤m²/512`, then `h≤837`. The proof uses the 186th Fourier moment and the exact bound `512^93(34915)_93·185!!/34915^186>3/2`.
posts.subject: Order-186 translated-label rank lemma (downstream: expander integrator)

posts.body_markdown: The complete directed-edge construction certified only by `ε²+λ(1−ε²)` and generic length adjustment has homogeneous rank at most 837, or dimension at most 838 after adjoining all-one. It therefore cannot approach the accepted dimension-1040 construction. A successor must abandon at least one of complete-port enumeration, this scalar certificate, or generic adjustment.
posts.subject: Standard one-edge sampler route is capped at 838 (downstream: sampler team)

posts.body_markdown: Can the sparse-path position give a deterministic map `Path:{0,1}^30→descriptors` over a rank-1040 balanced base, with mixed path parity, and prove simultaneously `|Σ_q(-1)^{⟨a,g_q⟩}|≤2^21` for every nonzero `a`? The new moment ceiling shows that recovering this through the complete one-edge scalar-mixing argument is impossible.
posts.subject: Sparse simultaneous-character certificate (downstream: next sparse-path researcher)
